subject.title: Subagent process death emits no telemetry — sessions_spawn failures leave no span/trace

question: What stable diagnostics contract should OpenClaw expose for spawned subagent death or termination events?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but event name, reason taxonomy, redaction/cardinality policy, and parent span relationship are public observability contract choices.

options.title: Add subagent terminal event
options.body: Emit a trusted diagnostic event from subagent lost-context, killed, and terminal reconciliation paths, then export it to OTel with bounded attributes.

options.title: Annotate only the spawn/tool span
options.body: Attach the death information to the parent sessions_spawn or run span, accepting weaker coverage for deaths that occur after the spawn call has returned.

options.title: Fold into broader dispatch telemetry
options.body: Defer this marker into the wider receiver-entry and dispatch telemetry design, accepting that subagent death clustering remains blind until that lands.

recommendation.title: Add subagent terminal event
recommendation.body: Emit a trusted diagnostic event from subagent lost-context, killed, and terminal reconciliation paths, then export it to OTel with bounded attributes.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision starts at the subagent registry terminal paths where the event would originate, and the strongest history signal for those files points to steipete.
